# Lab 26.8: Isolate & Snapshot a Compromised VM

## What We Are Going to Do
Isolate a suspicious VM with firewall rules, preserve its disk as evidence, and analyse a copy in a separate forensics project.

## Steps

1. **Create the "compromised" VM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances create suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Protect it from deletion and label it.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances update suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --deletion-protection
gcloud compute instances add-labels suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --labels=ir-case=case-001
gcloud compute instances add-tags suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --tags=quarantine</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Isolate it.** Highest-priority deny rules for the tag, both directions.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-rules create quarantine-deny-in --network=default \
  --direction=INGRESS --action=DENY --rules=all --source-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 \
  --target-tags=quarantine --priority=0 --enable-logging
gcloud compute firewall-rules create quarantine-deny-out --network=default \
  --direction=EGRESS --action=DENY --rules=all --destination-ranges=0.0.0.0/0 \
  --target-tags=quarantine --priority=0 --enable-logging</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Do not delete or stop the VM yet. Running state can hold evidence.

4. **Snapshot the disk.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute snapshots create case-001-snap \
  --source-disk=suspect-vm --source-disk-zone=us-central1-a \
  --labels=ir-case=case-001 --storage-location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Remove its access to Google APIs.** Stop the VM and remove its service account.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances stop suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a
gcloud compute instances set-service-account suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --no-service-account --no-scopes</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Copy the evidence to a forensics project.** Grant the forensics team **Compute Storage Admin** on the snapshot's project, then:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute disks create case-001-disk --project=FORENSICS_PROJECT --zone=us-central1-a \
  --source-snapshot=projects/$PROJECT_ID/global/snapshots/case-001-snap
gcloud compute instances create forensic-ws --project=FORENSICS_PROJECT --zone=us-central1-a \
  --machine-type=e2-small --no-address
gcloud compute instances attach-disk forensic-ws --project=FORENSICS_PROJECT --zone=us-central1-a \
  --disk=case-001-disk --mode=ro</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The disk is attached read-only, so evidence is not changed.

7. **Clean up** after the exercise.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances update suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --no-deletion-protection
gcloud compute instances delete suspect-vm --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud compute firewall-rules delete quarantine-deny-in quarantine-deny-out --quiet
gcloud compute snapshots delete case-001-snap --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Delete the forensics VM and disk in the forensics project.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Network | All traffic to and from the VM denied |
| Evidence | Snapshot taken before changes |
| Analysis | On a read-only copy in another project |
| Deletion | Blocked until the case is closed |
